District Court Drafting: The Hard Reality 

Drafting sirf words likhne ka kaam nahi hai.
Har fact, har clause aur har prayer matter karti hai.

Ek chhoti drafting mistake case ki direction badal sakti hai.
Court mein draft hi aapka pehla argument hota hai.

📌 Draft carefully. Plead precisely. Practice professionally.

Gaurang Singh 

DraftKaari — Draft Like a Lawyer. Argue Like a Pro.
